<page>
 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0009
 Todd Lee, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
9-12-25
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
Subject to and without waivnig the foregoing general denial, Defendant asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's alleged injuries and damages were not proximately caused by any negligent act or omission of
Defendant. The collision at issue was caused, in whole or in part, by the acts or omissions of Plaintiff, including
following too closely and failing to keep a proper lookout.
Second, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by unreasonably delaying or declining recommended medical treatment,
and any recovery must be reduced accordingly.
Third, under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, Defendant requests that the trier of fact
determine the percentage of responsibility attributable to Plaintiff and any other responsible third party, and that any
recovery be reduced or barred in accordance with the proportionate responsibility statute.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this Answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
